description: Several changes as ONE undo step, all or nothing: if any operation fails, none are applied and the error says which. Each operation is { tool, args } using update_element, create_walls, create_room, place_opening, place_furniture, place_column, place_beam, place_ramp, place_lift, place_parking, create_grid, paint_surface, apply_palette, set_sky, save_view, create_level, copy_level, set_properties, define_property or remove_property. Use it for multi-step edits the user would think of as one change.

label.description: Short name for the undo step, e.g. "Furnish bedroom"

name: batch
title: Batch of changes
